subject: Fix deprecated std::atomic_load/store warnings for shared_ptr (#548)
reason: The change only adds #pragma GCC diagnostic push/ignored(-Wdeprecated-declarations)/pop around the existing std::atomic_load/std::atomic_store calls on cluster_map_ in valkey_search.cc and valkey_search.h. No code path, argument, or logic changes: the same atomic load/store calls execute identically; only compile-time warning emission is suppressed. A warning-suppression build change has no observable runtime behavior to compare or stress, so no scenario is needed.
